article.title: From Palestine to Lebanon, and now Syria, Israel is destroying the Arab olive harvest
article.author: Areej Louay Ali
article.content: The Israeli army is cutting farmers off from their groves in Quneitra, southern Syria, and detaining young men in the area arbitrarily. Locals tell Mondoweiss that the losses from the olive harvest will take decades to recover from.
